name: card
title: Card
author: @fma-ds/ds
description:
A container for grouping related content, with header, title, description, action, content, and footer slots. Supports a compact size="sm" variant.

`CardContent bleed` drops the content's side padding, so a table, a list or an image spans the card's edges; `bleed="end"`, for content that closes the card, also drops the card's bottom padding, like a `CardFooter` does. `CardHeader sticky` and `CardFooter sticky` stay at the top and bottom of the screen while a long card scrolls, on an opaque surface; the header stops below `--sticky-edge` (the page's sticky bars, which `AppShellMain` sets). The card clips its corners with `overflow: clip`, which doesn't make it a scroll container, so they stick to the page.
